title: Averaging a single local factor against the Bernoulli weight
hypotheses_covered: sum over the three per-coordinate values (free, fixed-false, fixed-true)
replaced:
For $p \in \bbr$, sets $U, S$ and a coordinate $i$,
\[
  \sum_{v} \mathrm{varWeight}\,p\,v \cdot \mathrm{localFactor}\,U\,S\,i\,v
  \;=\; \begin{cases} p & i \in S,\\ 0 & i \in U \setminus S,\\ 1 & \text{otherwise.}\end{cases}
\]
